successCriteria.description: Create `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exporting the `LeaveRequest` interface with all required fields: id (number), employeeId (number), leaveTypeId (number), startDate (Date), endDate (Date), reason (string), status (LeaveStatus imported from src/shared/types/leave.types.ts), approvedBy (number | null), approvedAt (Date | null), rejectedBy (number | null), rejectedAt (Date | null), rejectionReason (string | null), cancelledBy (number | null), cancelledAt (Date | null), cancellationReason (string | null), createdAt (Date), updatedAt (Date).
Create `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exporting `CreateLeaveRequestDto` with fields: employeeId (number), leaveTypeId (number), startDate (Date), endDate (Date), reason (string).
Create `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exporting `UpdateLeaveRequestDto` with optional fields: startDate, endDate, reason, leaveTypeId — all optional for partial updates.
Create `src/modules/leave/leave.model.ts` exporting `LeaveRequestQueryParams` DTO with optional filter fields: employeeId, leaveTypeId, status (LeaveStatus), startDate, endDate.

Create `src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts` exporting the `ILeaveRepository` interface with method signatures: findById(id: number): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, findByEmployeeId(employeeId: number): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, findByStatus(status: LeaveStatus): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, findByDateRange(startDate: Date, endDate: Date): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, findPendingForManager(managerId: number): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>, create(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>, update(id: number, dto: UpdateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>, updateStatus(id: number, status: LeaveStatus, actorInfo: { approvedBy?: number; approvedAt?: Date; rejectedBy?: number; rejectedAt?: Date; rejectionReason?: string; cancelledBy?: number; cancelledAt?: Date; cancellationReason?: string }): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>.

Create `src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts` exporting the `ILeaveRepository` interface with method signatures: findById, findByEmployeeId, findByStatus, findByDateRange, findPendingForManager, create, update, updateStatus — each returning Promise-wrapped LeaveRequest or arrays/null as appropriate.

Implement `LeaveRepository` class in `src/modules/leave/leave.repository.ts` that implements `ILeaveRepository` using the pg Pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`. Constructor accepts an optional Pool (defaulting to the shared pool). All methods execute parameterized SQL queries against a `leave_requests` table with snake_case column mapping.

Include Jest unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/leave/` covering: LeaveRequest interface shape validation, CreateLeaveRequestDto/UpdateLeaveRequestDto/LeaveRequestQueryParams DTOs, and LeaveRepository method behaviors (mocking the pg Pool).

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer (GP-001) — the LeaveRepository class is the sole point of SQL execution for leave_requests.
The `LeaveRequest` interface must import `LeaveStatus` from `src/shared/types/leave.types.ts` (Phase 1 dependency) — do not redefine or duplicate the enum.

Follow the established patterns from Phase 2 (policy) and Phase 3 (balance): model file exports interfaces/DTOs only (no runtime logic), repository file exports an interface + a class with constructor(dbPool: Pool = pool), parameterized SQL with snake_case column mapping, and dynamic UPDATE field building.
outOfScope: Leave service (ILeaveService / LeaveService) — deferred to Phase 7
Leave routes (Phase 10), leave service (Phase 7), and module barrel export index.ts (Phase 10)
Audit record writing (GP-002) — the repository layer in this phase does not write audit records; that responsibility belongs to the service layer in Phase 7
